description: A test program for the tuxbox-framebuffer device that tests various display modes and pixel formats, including setting display modes, drawing test patterns, and manipulating color maps.

methods.name: setmode
methods.description: Configures the framebuffer display mode and resolution using ioctl calls.

methods.name: drawrect
methods.description: Draws a rectangle with specified color and pixel format onto the framebuffer.

methods.name: draw4field
methods.description: Creates a test pattern with four colored quadrants on the display.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the program.

methods.name: col2pixel
methods.description: Converts a color to pixel data based on the pixel format.
